{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the unique values in 'channel' and 'customer_segment'
print("Channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Customer segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check the distribution of converted
print("Conversion rate overall:", df['converted'].mean())

# Check the current dtype of 'revenue'
print("Current dtype of 'revenue':", df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
